decisions.reason: The same message directly modifies the Hero V reach study, and the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the subtle extension, fixed geometry, and limited reopening.
The É accent is directly included in the shared refinement, and its existing same-message MODIFY already records the limited reach and terminal study while preserving its derivation rule.
The existing message-191 MODIFY already captures the Option B selection, reach and softening variants, consistency across all three glyphs, and removal of the obsolete prior refinement constraint.

The source refines the second V arm geometry while explicitly keeping the overall architecture unchanged; it does not change the established height hierarchy relative to the E, L, Hero V, or É accent.
The geometric refinement does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish or the champagne-gold distribution across the three signature elements.
The source applies the reach refinement consistently to the Hero V and É accent while keeping the architecture locked, so the existing exact peak-alignment rule remains valid unchanged.
The source is limited to the Hero V, second V, and É accent and explicitly keeps everything else unchanged; it does not alter the E or L design requirements.
Extending the second V right arm does not change the rule aligning the E and L cap height to the second V's left arm.
The source preserves everything outside the final glyph refinements and does not change the selected Balanced Flow kerning or cohesive-reading requirement.
The requested right-arm and terminal refinements do not alter the bottom-point baseline alignment of the two Vs with the E and L.
The source provides design feedback but does not change the separate task-local obligation to explain the rationale behind review rounds.
